note: Fictional. A clinic aide in Port Merrow is called to sign that she lives alone after a retired proximity scorer flagged her case; the scorer and its scores were deleted, so why she was picked can never be settled. Her reviewer and an analyst each hold a fragment the others lack. Conversations take place 6-12 March 2028, before the interview on 20 March.
